rules: The range-vs-volume correlation band has moved to 63 days: TS_CORR(TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 5), $high - $low, 63) scored 5.235 and a bare 63-day TS_CORR($volume, $high - $low) leg scored 4.609, while the same kernel at 21 days was rejected at rho 0.817. Keep the corr window at 63 and put any short window on the volume leg, not on the corr.

Wrapping or re-normalising the volume leg does not decorrelate a corr that reuses an archived window: TS_RANK($volume, 63) inside a 21-day corr hit rho 0.817, and swapping $dollar_volume / $open for $dollar_volume / TS_MEAN($dollar_volume, 21) hit rho 0.917. Move the corr window instead.

Dividing a fundamental by anything screens weakly. Fundamental-over-fundamental was 0 for 4 ($eps/$book_per_share 0.12, $accrual_gap/$asset_turnover 0.44, TS_DELTA($eps,63)/$book_per_share 0.10, TS_DELTA($book_per_share,63)/$book_per_share 0.63), and fundamental-over-price-level was the weakest surviving family (best accept 0.745, rejects at 0.51 and 0.66). Cross the fundamental with a price/volume leg instead of scaling it.

Normalise ranges and vols by TS_MEAN or TS_SUM of $high - $low, never by TS_MAX($high, w) - TS_MIN($low, w) or a TS_MIN/TS_MIN ratio: the extremum denominators were 0 for 3 at |t| 0.43-0.58, while the averaged-range denominators scored 3.205 and 3.178.

TS_DELTA($leverage, 63) cannot be the cross-sectional driver: three rejects at |t| 0.40-0.68 when it led the expression. It worked only at 126 days as the subtracted modifier next to a fundamental level rank (CS_RANK($roe) form, 4.051).

Bare short-window within-name rank legs are dead on the cheap screen: TS_RANK($volume, 3) 0.51, TS_RANK($open - $low, 5) 0.66, TS_ARGMIN($low, 10) 0.40, TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 21) - TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 5) 0.79. Second legs that carried accepts were volatility/range ratios or long-window ranks (TS_RANK($close, 126), TS_RANK(TS_STD($return, 5), 42)).
Sign and clip reductions destroy the second leg: SIGN(TS_DELTA($leverage, 63)) screened at 0.40 and TS_SUM(MIN($return, 0), 21) at 0.02, the worst of the round. Keep the magnitude of the leg.

$roa's bare rank is already in the archive and dominates rho, so multiplying CS_RANK($roa) by a mild price-vol ratio still collided at 0.930. Reserve $roa and $roe for difference forms and use $accrual_gap, $asset_turnover or $operating_margin * $asset_turnover as the fundamental leg of a product.
